correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed: exact Euclidean arclength density, nonnegative-mixture decomposition with mass O(epsilon^2 log(1/epsilon)), and the universal st<4 epsilon^2 necessary acute condition. Non-opposite middle signs yield only O(epsilon^2) or smaller measure using the global 1/2-Hölder bound for sqrt(1-x^2). Opposite middle signs yield st<epsilon^2 H with H->4(1-x^2); the planar hyperbola area is 2H epsilon^2 log(1/epsilon). Other vertex-angle constraints remove O(epsilon^2) area on compact x. Integrating the ordered density 3/4 and sign factor 2/8 gives exactly 2. Logarithmic coordinates and their Jacobian yield the stated joint independent limit. All exceptional arclength-mixture samples have acute-event total O(epsilon^4 log^2), negligible against the main asymptotic. A fresh executable independently samples actual perimeter density and direct dot products. No finite simulation is presented as an infinite proof.
